/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EMBARQUEPALLETNOPALLET'
		Do 'LoadEmbarquePalletNoPalletOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EMBARQUEPALLETMOTIVOERROR'
		Do 'LoadEmbarquePalletMotivoErrorOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Embarques.EmbarquePalletWCGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Embarques.EmbarquePalletWCGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Embarques.EmbarquePalletWCGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEMBARQUEPALLETNOPALLET"
				&TFEmbarquePalletNoPallet.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEMBARQUEPALLETNOPALLET_SEL"
				&TFEmbarquePalletNoPallet_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEMBARQUEPALLETMOTIVOERROR"
				&TFEmbarquePalletMotivoError.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEMBARQUEPALLETMOTIVOERROR_SEL"
				&TFEmbarquePalletMotivoError_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadEmbarquePalletNoPalletOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFEmbarquePalletNoPallet = &SearchTxt
	&TFEmbarquePalletNoPallet_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.EmbarquePallet
		Order EmbarquePalletNoPallet
		using EmbarquePalletWCDS(&TFEmbarquePalletNoPallet, &TFEmbarquePalletNoPallet_Sel, &TFEmbarquePalletMotivoError, &TFEmbarquePalletMotivoError_Sel)
		Where EmbarqueDetalleId = &EmbarqueDetalleId

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.EmbarquePallet
			Order EmbarquePalletNoPallet
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not EmbarquePalletNoPallet.IsEmpty()
			&Option = EmbarquePalletNoPallet
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadEmbarquePalletMotivoErrorOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFEmbarquePalletMotivoError = &SearchTxt
	&TFEmbarquePalletMotivoError_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.EmbarquePallet
		Order EmbarquePalletMotivoError
		using EmbarquePalletWCDS(&TFEmbarquePalletNoPallet, &TFEmbarquePalletNoPallet_Sel, &TFEmbarquePalletMotivoError, &TFEmbarquePalletMotivoError_Sel)
		Where Subscriptions.EmbarqueDetalleId = &EmbarqueDetalleId

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.EmbarquePallet
			Order EmbarquePalletMotivoError
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not EmbarquePalletMotivoError.IsEmpty()
			&Option = EmbarquePalletMotivoError
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
